name: world-wall-reset
description: Verify the five-minute world reset contract: wall blocks restore, physics debris clears, player stats remain, and all players return to spawn.

args.code:
local function observeIdleAndWave(deps)
 local idleTimeout,stableSeconds,minSamples=2,.2,3
 local retrySeconds,retryGap,outerSeconds=2,.1,2.5
 local result={idleReady=false,invokeCompleted=false,invokeOk=false,invokeAttempts=0,invokeCleanup=true}
 local ownedThread
 local function finite(value) return type(value)=='number' and value==value and value>-math.huge and value<math.huge end
 local began=deps.now()
 local lastTime=began
 local function clock()
  local now=deps.now()
  assert(finite(now) and now>=lastTime,'invalid observation clock')
  lastTime=now
  return now
 end
 local function sample()
  local state=deps.read()
  result.lastState=state
  assert(state.sameIdentity,'character or emote dependency replaced')
  return state
 end
 local function idle(state)
  return state.alive and state.grounded and state.unanchored and state.running
   and finite(state.move) and state.move<=.01 and finite(state.speed) and state.speed<=.05
 end
 local function packedResult(values)
  local ok,value,second=values[1],values[2],values[3]
  local entry={at=clock()-began,pcallOk=ok,returnCount=ok and values.n-1 or 0,
   firstKind=typeof(value),firstValue=ok and tostring(value):sub(1,120) or '',secondKind=typeof(second)}
  if not ok then entry.error=tostring(value):sub(1,180) end
  if typeof(second)=='Instance' then
   entry.secondClass=second.ClassName
   if second:IsA('AnimationTrack') then
    entry.trackPlaying=second.IsPlaying
    local animation=second.Animation
    entry.trackAnimationId=animation and tostring(animation.AnimationId):sub(1,100) or ''
   end
  end
  return entry
 end
 local ok,err=xpcall(function()
  assert(finite(began),'invalid initial clock')
  local deadline=began+idleTimeout
  local stableAt,stableCount=nil,0
  result.idleSamples=0
  repeat
   local now=clock()
   if now>=deadline then result.reason='idle_precondition_timeout' break end
   local state=sample()
   result.idleSamples+=1
   if idle(state) then
    if not stableAt then stableAt=now stableCount=0 end
    stableCount+=1
    if now-stableAt>=stableSeconds and stableCount>=minSamples then
     result.idleReady=true result.idleReadyAt=now-began
     result.stableSamples=stableCount result.stableSeconds=now-stableAt
     break
    end
   else stableAt=nil stableCount=0 end
   deps.wait(.05)
  until false
  result.idleElapsed=clock()-began
  if not result.idleReady then return end
  local waveBegan=clock()
  local outerDeadline=waveBegan+outerSeconds
  local completedAt
  ownedThread=deps.spawn(function()
   local taskOk,taskError=xpcall(function()
    local invokeDeadline=clock()+retrySeconds
    repeat
     sample()
     result.invokeAttempts+=1
     local values=table.pack(pcall(deps.invoke))
     local entry=packedResult(values)
     result.lastReturn=entry
     sample()
     if values[1] and values[2]==true then result.invokeOk=true break end
     if not result.firstRejection then result.firstRejection=entry end
     result.lastRejection=entry
     deps.wait(retryGap)
    until clock()>=invokeDeadline
   end,debug.traceback)
   if not taskOk then result.reason='invoke_observer_error' result.error=tostring(taskError):sub(1,280) end
   completedAt=clock()
   result.invokeCompleted=true
  end)
  repeat
   if result.invokeCompleted or clock()>=outerDeadline then break end
   deps.wait()
  until false
  if not result.invokeCompleted or not completedAt or completedAt>outerDeadline then
   result.invokeOk=false result.reason='invoke_timeout'
  elseif not result.invokeOk and not result.reason then result.reason='wave_rejected' end
  result.waveElapsed=clock()-waveBegan
  sample()
 end,debug.traceback)
 if not ok then result.reason='observation_error' result.error=tostring(err):sub(1,280) end
 if ownedThread and coroutine.status(ownedThread)~='dead' then
  local cancelled=pcall(deps.cancel,ownedThread)
  result.invokeCleanup=cancelled and coroutine.status(ownedThread)=='dead'
 end
 local identityOK,state=pcall(deps.read)
 result.finalIdentity=identityOK and state.sameIdentity==true
 if identityOK then result.lastState=state end
 result.valid=ok and result.reason==nil and result.idleReady and result.invokeCompleted and result.invokeOk and result.invokeCleanup and result.finalIdentity
 return result
end
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
local character=p and p.Character
local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
local animate=character and character:FindFirstChild('Animate')
local playEmote=animate and animate:FindFirstChild('PlayEmote')
local function magnitude(value)
 if type(value)=='number' and value==value and value>-math.huge and value<math.huge then return value end
 return tostring(value)
end
local function readState()
 local count=0
 if animate then for _,child in ipairs(animate:GetChildren()) do if child.Name=='PlayEmote' then count+=1 end end end
 local same=character~=nil and p.Character==character and character.Parent~=nil
  and humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Parent==character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')==humanoid
  and root~=nil and root:IsA('BasePart') and root.Parent==character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')==root
  and animate~=nil and animate:IsA('LocalScript') and animate.Enabled and animate.Parent==character and character:FindFirstChild('Animate')==animate
  and playEmote~=nil and playEmote:IsA('BindableFunction') and playEmote.Parent==animate and animate:FindFirstChild('PlayEmote')==playEmote and count==1
 local state=humanoid and humanoid:GetState()
 return {sameIdentity=same,alive=humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0,
  grounded=humanoid~=nil and humanoid.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air,
  unanchored=root~=nil and not root.Anchored,running=state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running,
  move=magnitude(humanoid and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude or -1),
  speed=magnitude(root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude or -1),
  state=state and state.Name or 'Missing',floor=humanoid and humanoid.FloorMaterial.Name or 'Missing'}
end
local result=observeIdleAndWave({now=os.clock,wait=task.wait,spawn=task.spawn,cancel=task.cancel,
 read=readState,invoke=function() return playEmote:Invoke('wave') end})
local children={}
local count=0
if animate then for _,child in ipairs(animate:GetChildren()) do
 if #children<20 then table.insert(children,(child.Name..':'..child.ClassName):sub(1,48)) end
 if child.Name=='PlayEmote' then count+=1 end
end end
table.sort(children)
result.phase="bootstrap"
result.contract='WorldResetEmoteReadinessV1'
result.animate=animate~=nil
result.playEmote=playEmote~=nil
result.playEmoteClass=playEmote and playEmote.ClassName or ''
result.playEmoteCount=count
result.hookOwned=playEmote~=nil and playEmote:GetAttribute('PunchWallOwnedFallback')==true
result.repairState=character and character:GetAttribute('PunchWallAnimateRepairState')
result.nativeHookReady=character~=nil and character:GetAttribute('PunchWallAnimateNativeHookReady')==true
result.probeTimeouts=character and character:GetAttribute('PunchWallAnimateProbeTimeouts') or 0
result.adoptedLate=character~=nil and character:GetAttribute('PunchWallAdoptedLatePlayEmoteHook')==true
result.animateEnabled=animate~=nil and animate.Enabled
result.repaired=character~=nil and character:GetAttribute('PunchWallRepairedPlayEmoteHook')==true
result.duplicateRemoved=character~=nil and character:GetAttribute('PunchWallRemovedDuplicatePlayEmoteHook')==true
result.classMismatch=character and character:GetAttribute('PunchWallPlayEmoteHookClassMismatch') or ''
result.children=children
local encoded=H:JSONEncode(result)
assert(#encoded<3900,'world reset emote diagnostics exceed evidence bound')
print('[SMASH_WORLD_RESET_EMOTE_V1]'..encoded)
return encoded
